headline:
Down sharply
from its highs
chart_note: 52-week range: $98.88 - $135.16. Currently around $107, roughly 23% up from the low but still about 21% below the high.
why_today: Trading roughly 21% below its 52-week high - growth has slowed to single digits and the market has been repricing the stock down accordingly.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Buy (84% of 43 analysts), and the pullback from highs has made the stock noticeably cheaper than a few months ago
pro_2: Low beta (0.58) and a steady, growing dividend make it a defensive holding even in the current pullback
con_1: PEG ratio of about 3.2x is expensive relative to the growth rate - revenue growth has slowed to just 2.5% in the most recent quarter
con_2: PE of 38.8x is high for a low-single-digit grower - the valuation still assumes a return to faster growth
